statement: Cheapest route that still gets the right outcome; never a deep run for a question

Each reply states the facts held in the account (the named pivot facts), is handled inline or handed to a deep run as the request needs, makes exactly the database changes asked for and none other, and meets every item of the case rubric, judged on a rich realistic account
Final quest state matches the request exactly
Relevant evidence within a read budget, failing soft
Right passage per query at lowest search spend
Cheapest tier that passes the task; vendor swappable by config

Goal met within the turn and cost budget on the cheapest runner that can do the edit; every outcome (met, no-op, paused on a human, partial, crashed, missing binary) reported back the same way whichever runner ran

Every run that is idle without cause, blocked on a person, at a usage limit or repeating the same action is stopped, and no run that is making slow progress is stopped; a wrong stop loses work that was about to land, so false stops weigh more than missed stops
No write outside the configured root; every write reversible
Exactly the requested mutation, once
Every confirm reaches a person with enough detail to decide
Live shows everything; background shows only milestones
Right prior turn recalled, nothing leaked across users
Right files in the top 3 at the lowest token cost
No lost or duplicated cards; same behaviour on every backend
Recall at fixed latency
Same correction is never needed twice
Messages delivered once, in order
Same result as the slow path at a fraction of the cost
Few interventions, each correct
Every changed or deleted file is flagged, no unchanged file is
Every assembly point stays under a budget derived from the model window and the cost per call, with zero duplicated blocks
A malformed, hallucinated or missing verdict never changes a turn; the model sees the evidence its question depends on
No unverified link is sent; a lookalike request never triggers a write; chips appear only when a pattern is strong enough
Every new human-authored item is offered once; answered and already-seen items are not repeated; the assistant's own echoes and unattributed notes are left out; age and count bounds hold
Every correction is stored verbatim with who gave it and when, survives a restart, and a one-time request is kept apart from a standing rule
The cards from the last turns of this quest are available to the next turn when they bear on it; a card from another quest, or a stale one, is never returned
A message sent before or during a run reaches the next planner decision exactly once, only for its own conversation, and is never silently lost
A pointer resolves to fresh text within the character budget; an unresolvable pointer becomes a stated unresolved line and costs nothing else

The caller sees the same behaviour with or without a cache and the outage stays loud; the stored listing survives a restart so a cold start during an outage still serves cards, and no failed write is lost
Every reply to an ESOI-relevant request does what the principle asks, and never adds structure whose cost outweighs its benefit
The judge passes a reply that does what the principle asks and fails one that does not, agreeing with a human reviewer on the reference good and bad replies
Every injected structure violation is reported by rule and path, and a clean repository is never flagged
Every documented name imports, every registration takes effect, every front door and helper behaves on fixture inputs, and nothing needs a network or a model to import
Every shipped example runs as documented on an empty environment and leaks nothing
Every due task is claimed once, run by the right persona against its quest folder, and reported done, failed or needs-you; none is run twice, dropped, or run before its time

The file is a baseline, an environment variable beats it, a process variable beats the file's own env tables, a typo or unsupported key fails loudly at startup, and a malformed tuning value falls back to its default
Every non-interactive subcommand parses, prints what the person needs to act, and a bad invocation is refused with the usage exit code before anything is done

The planner's difficulty rating picks the starting rung, a family name resolves to the newest live release, an operator pin always wins, an exhausted tier falls to the next cheaper one, and an outage or usage limit is recognised and resumed after its reset

Per-model prices are right (unknown models fall back to a stated default), the daily budget survives a restart and resets each day, and an overloaded host pauses pickup with hysteresis instead of flapping
Every test file imports and collects, no test silently disappears, and no test file passes the size ceiling without a waiver, found in under a minute with no model call
A planted secret of any known kind is found before commit, a documented placeholder is never flagged, and the repository itself scans clean
A name, a config override or the table default picks the class, in that order; a typo raises with the choices; every table entry imports; a config change switches the live implementation

The winner has the higher pass rate (equal rate: lower cost), rows on different case files are never compared, rows without provenance are flagged, a tie is not a win, every record carries the commit and the case file hash, and a call budget aborts a run
Every generated documentation case passes: no broken link, no orphan document, nothing undocumented, no em dash
Whatever backs the PredictionStore port returns exactly what was saved, never leaks between scopes, drops expired predictions, survives a restart and never raises
Practical evolvable structure first: Structure is prioritised when it raises the chance the intent is optimally fulfilled in the optimal timeframe; the design itself keeps evolving
metric_ids: Every file belongs to one component in components.csv (S1) and every component serves a solution (S19)

statement: Ontology of solutions with ideals and metrics: A separate defined component for every use case whose 'best' differs; each solution states what it does and its interface, has one or more ideals and a practical metric
metric_ids: Every port has a solutions.csv row with an ideal and a metric or a stated gap (S7, S11)

statement: Source of truth for solutions: One structure records which implementation is selected, the metrics, and lets interdependent interfaces keep working while implementations change
metric_ids: solutions.csv plus core/selection_table.py plus the tracker tabs (S7, S14, S17)

statement: Automatic use of the best implementation: The authoritative metric chooses the implementation; humans review metrics, not implementations
metric_ids: The selected implementation is the leaderboard winner or a waiver names the pending decision (S10)

statement: Structure improves over time: The structure itself is iterated to serve its purpose and niche; what is intentionally changeable is marked
metric_ids: Each solution row states its gap and action; waivers can only shrink (S7, S9)

statement: High-level principles get the same treatment: Problems, ideals and solutions are defined proactively for principles and behaviour, not only for artifacts
metric_ids: The esoi_behavior component scores whether the AI's own behaviour follows ESOI

statement: Humility: Metrics decide, not opinion; alternative perspectives are implementations
metric_ids: Unmeasured solutions are flagged, not assumed good (S7); challengers stay on the leaderboard

statement: Leverage existing structure: Use what exists (science, open source, public data, advice) and keep awareness of it only where useful
metric_ids: Vendored code is a component; reference adapters and providers are reused behind ports

statement: No duplication across dimensions: Horizontal, vertical, topical and generational duplication is avoided where the structure's cost does not outweigh its benefit
metric_ids: A port or module is defined once; role mixins; re-exports instead of copies (S4)

statement: Long-term outcomes cascade to tasks: Real-system tests and KPIs beat unit tests and task completion; the problem solved in the wild is what matters
metric_ids: evaluation/components measures real behaviour; results.csv records provenance (S16)

statement: Avoid retaining what is not useful: Edit in a way that is useful next time; iterate the same files; use a scalable source of truth; no per-session files
metric_ids: One registry iterated in place; scratch lives in scratch/ or /tmp (S3)

statement: Minimalism and simplicity: Applications of the structure specify only what differs; elegant interfaces even if complex underneath
metric_ids: Configuration enters through RunnerConfig only (S13, S15); a lane is a config file

statement: Clarity: Naming, concise wording and organisation that lets a reader read only what they need
metric_ids: Every module opens with a docstring stating its role (S5); every component states its role (S2)
